q: Who fired the shots at Mainila?

fi.text: Neuvostoliitto lavasti 26. marraskuuta 1939 Mainilan laukaukset , joilla se perusteli sotaa puolustuksellisena toimenpiteenä.
fi.gloss: The Soviet Union staged the Mainila shots on 26 November 1939, with which it justified the war as a defensive measure.

en.text: On 26 November 1939, an incident was reported near the Soviet village of Mainila , near the border with Finland.

ru.text: В тот же день произошёл артиллерийский обстрел территории СССР у населённого пункта Майнила .
ru.gloss: On the same day an artillery shelling of USSR territory took place near the settlement of Mainila.
